 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-227168fb.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    source = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if grid[r][c] not in (background, 0)]
    target = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    if not source or not target:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    sr0 = min(r for r, _ in source)
    sr1 = max(r for r, _ in source)
    sc0 = min(c for _, c in source)
    sc1 = max(c for _, c in source)
    tr0 = min(r for r, _ in target)
    tc0 = min(c for _, c in target)
    th = max(r for r, _ in target) - tr0 + 1
    tw = max(c for _, c in target) - tc0 + 1

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(th):
        for dc in range(tw):
            out[tr0 + dr][tc0 + dc] = grid[sr0 + dr][sc1 - dc]
    return out
"
